name: Bisbee
seo_title: Bisbee Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Bisbee, Arizona for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Bisbee celebrates with its Festival of Lights downtown, a Boys and Girls Club Christmas festival and holiday workshops at the Copper Queen Library.
celebrates: Bisbee kicks off Christmas with the City's Festival of Lights on the Friday after Thanksgiving, now in its 36th year. Explore Cochise says families can craft an ornament, vote for a favorite shop window and enjoy entertainers while supporting Bisbee artisans and small businesses. The Boys and Girls Club of Bisbee hosts a Merry and Bright Christmas Festival on December 12. At the Copper Queen Library, kids decorate ugly holiday sweaters on two Fridays and the Friends of the Library host a holiday party with the Bisbee Community Chorus.
lastyear: In 2025, Warren Ballpark hosted the Arizona Vintage Baseball Holiday Huzzah Christmas Classic on December 20, with gates opening at 10:30 am and games from 11 am to 3:30 pm. For 2026 we found no new date for the ballpark event on an official page, so it is not listed here, and the Bisbee Festival of Lights is the main downtown event.
facts: Bisbee has been registered as an Arts and Cultural District, which Explore Cochise says treats art, culture and heritage as vital to the town's character. The town is known as progressive and free-spirited, with murals on different corners, colorful houses and a collective of local artists. The Festival of Lights is in its 36th year in 2026, according to the City of Bisbee's notice.
trains: Bisbee does not have a passenger train today. Our site lists the Benson Visitor Center Train Depot, a replica of the original depot in the Southern Pacific railroad town of Benson, as the closest depot-themed stop. The Queen Mine Tour and the Bisbee Mining and Historical Museum are popular kid stops on travel sites, though we found no 2026 holiday train date on an official page.

faq: When is the Bisbee Festival of Lights in 2026?

The City of Bisbee announces the 36th Annual Festival of Lights for Friday, November 27, 2026, from 8 am to 10 pm at City Park. Explore Cochise describes entertainers, ornament crafting and a shop window vote. The city notice does not print an admission price.
Where can kids decorate an ugly holiday sweater in Bisbee?

Copper Queen Library holds the workshop on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 1 to 3 pm at the Annex, 519 W Melody Lane, and Friday, December 18, from 1 to 3 pm at the Main Library, 6 Main Street. The city calendar says all ages and skill levels are welcome and participation is free.
What is the Merry and Bright Christmas Festival in Bisbee?

The Boys and Girls Club of Bisbee hosts it on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm at 405 Arizona Street. The club's Facebook event page advertises family fun and a dinner sale. No admission price is printed, so ask the club before you go.
Is there a holiday concert in Bisbee for families?

Yes. The Friends of the Copper Queen Library hold their annual holiday party on Tuesday, December 15, 2026, from 4 to 5 pm at the library, 6 Main Street. The Bisbee Community Chorus then sings from 5 to 6 pm. The City of Bisbee calendar lists it as free.
note: Festival of Lights address (62 Brewery Ave) and times come from the City of Bisbee DocumentCenter notice via the research agent; lead should confirm. Small Town Holiday and tree lighting had no verifiable 2026 date, held.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Bisbee for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the 36th Annual Festival of Lights) through December 18 (the second Ugly Holiday Sweater Workshop), with the Merry and Bright Christmas Festival (December 12) and the Friends of the Copper Queen Library Holiday Party with the Bisbee Community Chorus (December 15) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
